"""Datasets for the 'Where RR lose under pressure' dashboard (steps 1-2, final definition)."""
import json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, pathlib
W = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/work"); O = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/dash4"); CODE = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
def dump(name, df, inputs):
    rows = json.loads(df.replace({np.nan: None}).to_json(orient="records"))
    (O / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"rows": rows, "meta": [{"label": "s24_dash_moments.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python"}, {"label": "Input", "value": inputs}]}))
    print(name, len(rows))
M = pd.read_csv(W / "final_moments.csv"); dump("moments", M, "final_moments.csv (s21_rr_moments.py, s22_final_moments.py)")
dump("moment_players", pd.read_csv(W / "final_moment_players.csv"), "final_moment_players.csv (s22_final_moments.py): IPL 2023-26, any team")
pos = pd.read_csv(W / "roles_batting_pos.csv"); mo = pd.read_csv(W / "roles_middle_bat.csv"); mo["pos"] = "All batters, overs 7-15"
bat = pd.concat([pos, mo])[["season", "team", "group", "pos", "sr", "wkts_per_inns", "dot_pct", "bnd_pct", "runs", "balls", "outs"]].copy()
bat["avg"] = bat.runs / bat.outs; bat = bat.rename(columns={"pos": "role"}); bat["label"] = bat.team + " " + bat.season.astype(str)
dump("bat_roles", bat.round(2), "roles_batting_pos.csv, roles_middle_bat.csv (s20_roles.py): IPL 2022-26 team-seasons")
bp = pd.read_csv(W / "roles_bowling_phase.csv")[["season", "team", "group", "phase", "econ", "balls_per_wkt", "wkts_per_inns", "dot_pct", "bnd_pct"]].copy()
bp["label"] = bp.team + " " + bp.season.astype(str); dump("bowl_roles", bp.round(2), "roles_bowling_phase.csv (s20_roles.py): IPL 2022-26 team-seasons")
ar = pd.read_csv(W / "roles_allrounders.csv")[["season", "team", "group", "overs_by_top7_per_match", "allrounders_used", "genuine_allrounders", "allrounder_runs", "allrounder_wkts", "allrounder_econ", "lower_order_avg", "lower_order_sr", "allrounder_names"]].copy()
ar["label"] = ar.team + " " + ar.season.astype(str); dump("allrounders", ar.round(2), "roles_allrounders.csv (s20_roles.py)")
EXCL = {"Harry Brook", "Andre Russell", "Ajinkya Rahane", "Ravichandran Ashwin"}
for kind in ["bat", "bowl"]:
    n = pd.read_csv(W / f"fin_ratings_{kind}.csv", index_col=0); n = n[(n.last_team != "Pakistan") & ~n.name.isin(EXCL)].copy(); n["rank"] = np.arange(1, len(n) + 1)
    n["top10_in_resamples_pct"] = (100 * n.boot_top10).round(0); n["team"] = n.ipl_team_latest.fillna("No IPL team")
    cols = ["rank", "name", "team", "pb", "top10_in_resamples_pct"] + (["SR_P", "SR_N"] if kind == "bat" else ["Econ_P", "Econ_N"])
    dump(f"top_{kind}", n[cols].head(15).round(1), f"fin_ratings_{kind}.csv (s23_unified_final.py)")
